name: Project Folderbase
description: Optional starting guidance for a bounded body of work with an outcome and finish line.

questions.prompt: What should this project folderbase be called?
What bounded outcome does this project exist to achieve?
What is true about the project, its risks, and its progress right now?
What is the next concrete action?

artifacts.x-purpose: Consequential project decisions and their rationale.

artifacts.content:
# ${folderbase_name}

## Purpose
${purpose}

## Current state
${current_state}

## Navigate
- `Decisions/` — consequential decisions and why they were made.
- `Deliverables/` — project outputs and handoff material.

## Operating rules
- Keep this folderbase centered on one bounded outcome and its finish line.
- Treat the layout as starting guidance; reorganize it when the project needs a clearer shape.
- Template kind, ancestry, and folder nesting grant no access.

## Unresolved work
- Next action: ${next_action}

upgrade_edges.notes: Completes the concise folderbase entry with navigation, operating rules, and unresolved work.
